plain: Rich, costly living; great enjoyment of fine food, clothes and comforts

webster.text: A free or extravagant indulgence in the pleasures of the table, as in rich and expensive diet, or delicious food and liquors; voluptuousness in the gratification of appetite; or the free indulgence in costly dress and equipage.

example.quote: As the poverty of individuals prevents luxury, so the poverty of public bodies, whether sole or aggregate, prevents tyranny.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Mr. BOWDOIN, January 22, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
